name: op_amp_unity_gain
description: Unity-gain buffer AC sweep. DC should give VOUT = VIN. AC gain should be ~0 dB across the passband (well below GBW=1 MHz), rolling off above that. Verifies the ac_model → single-pole op-amp subckt path end-to-end.

VOUT.rationale: Unity-gain buffer: V(OUT) = V(IN+) with 100 dB DC loop gain; error < V(IN+)/A0 = 10 µV.

expected.rationale: Passband: unity-gain feedback, closed-loop bandwidth = GBW = 1 MHz. At 100 Hz we're 4 decades below → gain flat at 0 dB.
Still 2 decades below closed-loop bandwidth; gain still flat.
At GBW (=closed-loop bandwidth for a unity-gain buffer), gain crosses -3 dB.
